author: JandJSecurity
body: My last post didn't work, so here's a new one. LJT143 shouldn't have been banned. I was with him at the time of the ban, and he was not hacking. He had a big lag spike, which caused the effect of antiknockback. He has a good computer and a relatively low ping which caused him to move faster than normal. I still don't understand, however how the mods just came to the conclusion that he was hacking. This explains how that he may have looked like he was hacking but he wasn't. Please unban LJT143. Everyone deserves a second chance.
